checks.result: No private project path/import or prior Agentura/Pipeline/Veera source markers found in source/art/scripts. All implementation was written independently. No databases/dumps/cookies or captured user state are supplied as app assets.
VITE_MOCKS defaults enabled and .env.example sets true. Browser worker initializes before React; public/mockServiceWorker.js exists. No real backend, secrets or private service is needed.

Older-generation successful auth/session responses throw CanceledError before generation or query-cache writes. All session query functions forward AbortSignal; accepted login awaits cancellation before clear/setuser. Deterministic old200null regression passed.

checks.check: Late failure and mutation across user change
checks.result: Captured generation is validated on private/cart requests; stale401 does not clear a newer client session. Regression covers staleprofile mutation and stale logout.

Order lookup validates current user owns order; attempt lookup keys include user ID. Creation normalizes exact fields, compares canonical content for repeated keys and validates the immutable quote. Idempotency key is in JSON body, as documented; no Idempotency-Key header claim is made.

ETH arithmetic uses BigInt with decimal-string transport. Quantity validation forbids zero/fractional persisted values. Reservation, confirmation/refusal and cart subtraction are serialized in the mock instance; receipts retain price snapshots.

socket.io-client is dynamically imported after MSW interception and uses custom marketplace-events path with socket.io-binding. New events invalidate REST projections; versions and session scope discard old/foreign updates. Fixed replay and soldout scenarios use network handlers, not component cache mutation.

Actual GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE service responses are parsed with complete Zod4schemas. DecimalETHstrings preserve18places; invalid versions, quantities, catalogpagination, walletshape and orderstatus are rejected before cache/application state.

simulationLimits: Browser-local demo with fictitious identities, not production authentication or authorization. Any user controlling the browser can inspect/change its demo state.
Session-generation headers prevent UI races; they are not cryptographic access tokens. Raw fixture fetch without generation remains supported.
Mutation serialization is per mock instance. It does not guarantee transactions across tabs/devices or a distributed payment system.
No real blockchain, wallet connection, payment gateway or personal-data processing is performed.
Assets are synthetic; exact Figma fidelity was not certified because the upstream design was inaccessible.
releaseConditions: Final consolidated tests, typecheck/build and package secret review pass for the same source snapshot.
Publish as demonstration with simulation limits visible. Do not describe this gate as a production-security certification.
Actual candidacy submission must preserve known design/performance/coverage limitations, not claim every assessment requirement was certified.
